title: Installment Premium Schedule for Deficiency Balance Account Settlements
content:
**Schedule.** The installment premium of an installment settlement on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is set in premium points, the band's lowest installment-settlement percent less its lowest lump-sum settlement percent:

1. When the latest arrangement offer of the account with the status broken has a broken date fewer than 12 whole months before today, the premium is the premium points of the original deficiency instead of the balance.
2. When there is no such broken arrangement but fewer than 12 whole months have run from the opening date to today, the premium is the greater of the premium points of the balance and the band's settlement floor.
3. Otherwise the premium is the premium points of the balance.

Each premium is rounded half up to the cent before any comparison. Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's. No two arrangements of an account break on the same day, since an account has only one arrangement in force at a time; the latest broken arrangement may be a plan or a settlement.

## Band figures

| Band | Installment-settlement percent | Lump-sum percent | Premium points | Settlement floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Band 1 | 70.0% | 60.0% | 10.0 | $250.00 |
| Band 2 | 65.0% | 55.0% | 10.0 | $500.00 |
| Band 3 | 60.0% | 50.0% | 10.0 | $750.00 |
| Band 4 | 55.0% | 45.0% | 10.0 | $1000.00 |
| Band 5 | 50.0% | 40.0% | 10.0 | $1500.00 |
| Band 6 | 45.0% | 35.0% | 10.0 | $2000.00 |

## Decision table

| Latest break fewer than 12 whole months ago | Opened fewer than 12 whole months ago | Premium |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | Premium points of the original deficiency |
| No | Yes | Greater of the premium points of the balance and the floor |
| No | No | Premium points of the balance |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Band 4, original deficiency $11,000.00, balance $10,000.00, a plan broken five whole months ago: the premium is $1,100.00.
- Band 5, balance $13,000.00, no broken arrangement, opened seven whole months ago: the greater of $1,300.00 and $1500.00, that is $1500.00.
- Band 5, balance $13,000.00, no broken arrangement, opened 12 whole months ago: $1,300.00.
